# orch8_cron_schedule (Resource)

A cron schedule that starts instances of a sequence version (`/cron`). `cron_expr`, `timezone`, `enabled`, `metadata` and `overlap_policy` update in place (`PUT /cron/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orch8_cron_schedule" "weekday_digest" {
  sequence_id    = orch8_sequence.welcome.id
  cron_expr      = "0 0 9 * * MON-FRI"
  timezone       = "Europe/Kyiv"
  overlap_policy = "skip"
  metadata       = jsonencode({ source = "terraform" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cron_expr` (String) Cron expression, e.g. `0 0 9 * * MON-FRI` (validated by the engine).
- `sequence_id` (String) UUID of the sequence version to run (e.g. `orch8_sequence.x.id`).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule fires. Defaults to true.
- `metadata` (String) JSON object merged into the metadata of created instances.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace for created instances. Defaults to `default`.
- `overlap_policy` (String) `allow` (default), `skip`, or `buffer_one`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Schedule UUID.
- `next_fire_at` (String) Next scheduled fire time.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by schedule UUID.
terraform import orch8_cron_schedule.weekday_digest 0194d2e6-7f44-7e2a-9c3e-1a2b3c4d5e70
```
